automatic_rejection_gates.condition: Concept output is described or presented as an actual, final, or product-accurate Everstory product.
The A5 sheet is severely distorted, cropped, folded, or occluded when the selected template requires a complete sheet.
The image invents an Everstory logo, packaging, fixed sticker count, material behavior, dimension label, or product claim not supplied by a confirmed source.
In reference_locked mode, customer identity, sticker count, layout, cut shape, header, or material appearance drifts from the actual product reference.
A visible hand has obviously incorrect fingers, joints, scale, or grip.
The result copies competitor branding or uses a loud, candy-pastel, scrapbook, or generic glossy-render direction.

score_categories.full_score: The product is immediately identifiable, dominant, readable, and appropriately scaled.
The output respects all confirmed facts and correctly treats provisional or reference-locked content.
The result feels warm, quiet, personal, tactile, editorial, and carefully made.
Framing, negative space, product scale, and prop placement support ecommerce clarity.
Soft window light, believable material response, contact shadows, hands, and perspective look photographic.
In Concept Mode, the provisional product area can be replaced without rebuilding the scene.
Aspect ratio, crop room, and visual hierarchy fit the intended Shopify or campaign slot.

score_interpretation.90_100: Approve. Eligible for Golden Style or Golden Product status if its mode permits.
score_interpretation.80_89: Revise once. Keep the image and change only the weakest variable.
score_interpretation.70_79: Major revision. Preserve only clearly successful elements.
score_interpretation.0_69: Reject and rebuild from the selected template.

required_checks: Concept status is explicit in the production record
Provisional artwork is not treated as product evidence

reference_locked.eligible_approval: Golden Product Reference or final ecommerce image
required_checks: Identity and geometry match the source
Sticker count and layout match the source
No source product details were invented or removed
The full preserve list remains unchanged
No cumulative product or identity drift is visible
